title: The candidate ref's lease delete and read-back are written twice, in _legs_cand_delete and _leg_candidate_clear
body: Found by CRITIC-4 on ST0011 WP02b-1 (its R2): _leg_candidate_clear (lib/cmd/release) repeats _legs_cand_delete's push --force-with-lease delete of the candidate ref and its _legs_cand_held read-back, judged unreadable, still held or gone, with only the wording and the 124 split different; fix: one helper answers ok, failed, unanswered, unreadable or held, and each caller words its own outcome. After the release, no work before it.
